title: BuyAndSale
subtitle: A national marketplace, built for real time.
description: A large-scale Cameroonian marketplace for buying and selling items in real time. I built the API and the experience end to end, with secure media uploads and a data model designed to scale.
imageAlt: BuyAndSale marketplace homepage, with a large orange hero and a grid of product categories

title: Rigo & Enzo
subtitle: A dealership catalogue that stays current.
description: A commercial showcase and dynamic catalogue for a car dealership, giving the team a simple way to publish and manage inventory in real time without touching code.
imageAlt: Rigo & Enzo vehicle marketplace homepage, with a purple hero image of a car and a search panel

title: Faucon
subtitle: Fleet telemetry, from tracker to control tower.
description: A fleet-telemetry product, now live on the web. An ESP32-C3 tracker publishes over MQTT with a local journal, GPS clock and adaptive WORK / MOVE / STANDBY modes. The Express and Prisma API handles geofences, alerts, HMAC-signed commands and scoped owner API keys. A real-time Next.js control tower and an Expo mobile app complete the chain.
highlights: Live HTTPS control tower: live position, trip replay, geofences and alerts
ESP32-C3 firmware with local journal, GPS clock and adaptive reporting modes
Owner API with scoped, revocable keys and read-only Socket.IO stream
MQTT telemetry and HMAC-signed remote commands, end to end
imageAlt: Faucon fleet telemetry landing page with a live map preview

title: LocatCam
subtitle: Student housing, end to end.
description: A housing platform for Cameroonian students: a .NET 10 API with JWT refresh tokens, geospatial listing search, messaging and moderation, paired with a .NET MAUI Android app with offline favourites. Containerised with Docker and covered by unit tests.

title: NkapLingua
subtitle: Financial accessibility, in three Cameroonian languages.
description: A browser extension that translates digital financial interfaces into Fulfulde, Ewondo and Duala without modifying the host site and without reading sensitive fields. Strict mode keeps balance, fees, PIN and OTP in French until a human-validated pack exists, and every action can be reversed. Prepared for the SAFINUM Innovate Challenge 2026 with Team ARTEMIS 237.
imageAlt: NkapLingua extension running over a fictional mobile-money banking interface in Fulfulde
highlights: Three languages: Fulfulde, Ewondo and Duala, with human packs and explicit status
Runs in Chrome (Manifest V3) and Firefox without touching the source page
Strict mode protects PIN, OTP, balance and fees from unvalidated machine translation
188/188 checks passed on the official test site, with full restoration

title: EcoTrack
subtitle: Routing waste collection across Douala.
description: A tutored academic project for waste collection management and route optimisation in Douala. Complete UML analysis, then a clean MVC implementation on the MERN stack — now deployed as a live demo.
imageAlt: EcoTrack homepage, with a green waste-collection hero and a report-a-dump call to action

title: Task
subtitle: Projects, people and deadlines in one view.
description: A project management and collaboration application with dynamic task allocation and an interactive deadline calendar. Designed, built and shipped end to end as a solo developer.

title: IDS Sprachschule
subtitle: The digital home of a language centre.
description: Ongoing development of the official web application for a prominent German language centre based in Yaoundé: courses, enrolment and institutional content, with a bilingual experience.
imageAlt: IDS Sprachschule homepage, with a full-screen photograph of students and a Learn German headline

title: Dr Tchuiffon Donald Raoul
subtitle: Research, made accessible.
description: A bilingual academic portfolio for an NHPSD university researcher, organising courses, publications and academic resources into one accessible, quietly elegant site.
imageAlt: Dr Tchuiffon Donald Raoul academic portfolio homepage, with a formal portrait and research introduction

title: GestActes
subtitle: Administrative acts, traceable from request to signature.
description: A civic workflow where a citizen requests an administrative act, an agent instructs it, a validator signs it, and the system archives it with a public verification page. Act contents live in a private GitHub repository: every change leaves a commit, every validation goes through a pull request, and every signed act carries a SHA-256 fingerprint.
imageAlt: GestActes public homepage for administrative acts in Douala
highlights: Role-based spaces for citizens, agents, validators and administrators
Git-backed audit trail: commits, pull requests and SHA-256 signatures
Public verification by reference number or QR code
pytest and Vitest suites wired into GitHub Actions
